title: feat: add --job flag to extract job script in config compile
description:
## Description

Adds `--job` flag to `glab ci config compile` to output the resolved shell script for a specific job (`before_script`, `script`, and `after_script`). If the job is missing, available jobs are listed in the error. Default merged YAML output remains unchanged.

## Related Issues

Resolves #8154
## How has this been tested?

- Unit tests in `internal/commands/ci/config/compile/compile_test.go` covering full scripts, missing job, invalid YAML, and default merged YAML (`make test-changed` passed).
- Manual testing with `./bin/glab ci config compile --job <name>` against sample CI config.
- Linters and pre-commit hooks passed cleanly.
